resolution_notes: Verifier B correctly flagged free_tier_limits/rate_limits/description for pricing accuracy. Official pricing (open-meteo.com/en/pricing, 2026) confirms free non-commercial use at 10,000 API calls/day under fair use, with commercial use requiring a subscription; the free-tier and rate-limit wording should stay that precise and omit unverified plan dollar amounts. Description should emphasize free non-commercial weather APIs (current/forecast/historical) with no API key, and not assert a specific commercial starting price.
free_tier_limits: 10,000 API calls/day for non-commercial use (fair-use); commercial use requires a subscription
rate_limits: 10,000 API calls/day free for non-commercial use (fair-use); higher commercial limits via paid plans
description: Open-Meteo provides free weather forecast APIs with no API key required. It offers current weather, forecasts, historical data, and related datasets worldwide. Free for non-commercial use; commercial use requires a paid subscription.
